title: A page opened in a space becomes its last page, which choosing the space opens
when: In a browser, opens a record and follows a link in its wiki to another, then goes to the products page and chooses the space.
then: Expects the rail's link to the space to name the page followed to, and choosing the space to open it.

title: A page opened shows in a tab: the preview is replaced in place, an open page activates its tab, and Back reopens a closed page as the preview
when: In a browser, opens a record, follows a link, keeps its tab with a double-click, follows another link, goes Back, closes the preview tab and goes Forward.
then: Expects the one preview tab replaced in place, the kept tab with a new preview after it, Back activating the kept tab with no second tab, and Forward reopening the closed page as the preview.

title: The address follows the active tab, clicked or cycled
when: In a browser, keeps a record's tab, follows a link into a new preview tab, clicks the first tab, then presses Ctrl+Tab.
then: Expects the address to name the first tab's page after the click, and the second's after Ctrl+Tab.

title: An opened window gets its app server
A closed window's server stops
manual_reason: Manual because it watches what only a person at the screen sees: a flash, the Dock and real windows. Run it after changing `desktop/src/main.ts`.
when: Step 6 of "A day with the desktop app": close every window, then run `ps -A | grep vite`.
then: No dev server the shell started is left.

title: An opened folder goes to the top of the recent folders
then: The folder went into the recent list.
